title: 高三短对话：地图与译文
source_notice: 高三公开期末标签的五短对话两遍/十秒和已解示例已核；原音轨缺，印本注释脚本/键可核，原校地域学期正文未认证，“上学期2月”标题疑点保留。本稿完整原创配套非来源gold或独立难度验证。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听后留10秒。另有一个已解示例，示例录音在材料1开头，示范一次属本机编排，不计入五题。本机可重播供审阅，不作正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The tour was supposed to leave at a quarter to ten.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: It has been delayed by half an hour. The guide is waiting for a replacement microphone.

questions.stem: When will the tour now leave?
questions.rationale: A：把延迟减了；B：9:45加30为10:15；C：误把原时间作10点

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can follow the footpaths on this map, but the river seems to cross a road twice.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The blue line is an old canal, now mostly dry. I should have made that clearer in the key before sending the design to the printer.

questions.stem: What is the woman responsible for?
questions.rationale: A：她编辑图例并送印；B：没有疏浚维护工作；C：无送货驾驶

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Your annual membership is ninety pounds. With the student discount, you pay two thirds of that.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Here is my student card. I would like to join today.

questions.stem: How much will the man pay?
questions.rationale: A：是减去的三分之一；B：未计学生折扣；C：90乘三分之二为60

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I thought the translation would be quick, but one paragraph took nearly an hour.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The words were ordinary. It was a joke that depended on how two words sounded, and a literal translation made no sense.

options: A joke based on similar sounds.
questions.rationale: A：明确词普通；B：谐音笑话直译无意义；C：未说手写难辨

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Will you publish the survey results as soon as the last form arrives?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I would rather check why so many answers came from one class first. The numbers may look precise without representing the whole school.

options: Whether the sample represents the school.
Whether the forms arrived too late.
Whether the chart looks colourful enough.
questions.rationale: A：大量来自单班引发代表性疑虑；B：不是担心迟到；C：未谈图表颜色

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The board still says platform two.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: There has just been an announcement. Our train now leaves from platform four.

question.stem: Which platform will the train leave from?
question.rationale: A：旧显示已被广播更改；B：未提三站台；C：最新广播为四站台
